_comment: The PUBLIC FIXTURE's floor, not the real chooser's: corpus/fixtures/behaviour-choice/. Its labels are a stand-in labeller, the hand-written rule (tools/behaviour-score.py rules) asked twice, so the floor records how often the committed model agrees with that rule on these 80 made-up creatures. It exercises the same check as the real floor (corpus/behaviour-choice/floor.json, Sonnet's labels), with its own numbers.
